description: This class provides centralized exception handling for a Spring Boot REST API related to shopping cart operations, mapping internal Java exceptions to HTTP responses with appropriate status codes and messages.

classes.name: ApiExceptionHandler
classes.description: A REST controller advice class that handles exceptions thrown within the cart web layer, converting Java exceptions into HTTP error responses.

methods.name: handleNotFound
methods.description: Handles NoSuchElementException by returning a 404 Not Found ProblemDetail with the exception message.

methods.name: handleErrorResponse
methods.description: Handles ErrorResponseException and returns its embedded ProblemDetail with the appropriate status.

methods.name: handleGeneric
methods.description: Handles any other unanticipated exceptions, logs the error, and returns a 500 Internal Server Error with a generic message.
